svg.text: AeroMet V1 — JGS1 fused-silica UV window (crown lid, over the dome board)
Section. All dimensions in mm. Scale ~12:1. Generated by mechanical/scripts/drawings.py.
1. Stock part: JGS1 UV-grade fused-silica round window Ø 20 x 2 mm, both faces polished, UNCOATED.
2. AliExpress: "Various Sizes JGS1 UV Grade Fused Silica Window Quartz Glass Polished Disk" (pick 20 x 2 mm),
3. or fiber-laser protective window "20x2" (WSX / Raytools type) ONLY if sold uncoated: 1064 nm AR coatings cut UV-B.
4. Tolerances that fit the lid: diameter 19.8-20.1 mm (bore Ø 20.8), thickness 1.8-2.2 mm (the nut thread takes it up).
5. Transmission needed: >= 85 % at 280-400 nm (GUVB-C31SM UV-B, LTR-390 UV-A), >= 90 % at 400-1100 nm.
6. Fitted from below: 17 x 1.0 mm O-ring against the lid lip, then the window, then the printed nut (hand-tight).
